newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ocean County, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, 1997 ELECTION, SERIES A

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Trustees of the Ocean View School District, Ventura County, California, intends to sell $2,000,000 principal amount of Ocean View School District General Obligation Bonds, 1997 Election, Series A. Bids will received on

at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Dale Scott & Company, Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA 94104, phone (415) 956-1030 or by facsimile at (415) 956-1322, and the sale will be awarded by the Superintendent of the Ocean View School District or her designee on behalf of the Board of Trustees of the Ocean View School District within twenty- six (26) hours after the bid opening is completed. In the event that the Superintendent or her authorized designee does not award a bid on the date specified above, proposals will be received the following Tuesday at the same time and place specified above and each Tuesday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. Further information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at the above address.
LEGALCOUNSEL: Bowie, Arneson, Kadi, Wiles & Giannone, Newport Beach, California.
